clips.title: The story
paras: Illiyana is an ancient dryad stationed in southwestern Ashenvale, dedicated to protecting the woodland from ancient corruption. Wandering near the Shrine of Aessina, she rallies champions of the Alliance to push back against the vicious satyrs that plague the ancient groves. Her vigilance represents the enduring bond between the daughters of Cenarius and the night elven wilderness.

Like all dryads, Illiyana is one of the daughters of the demigod Cenarius. Peaceful yet fiercely protective of wild lands, she patrols the woods of southwestern Ashenvale. As dark forces stir and the woodlands suffer under creeping corruption, Illiyana keeps watch over sacred relics and groves, acting as a steward for nature's primal sanctity.
